ctx.x: How long did it take to get to Baltimore?

Oh, it took a little while. Well, we were all in those long layoffs, you know -- those long layoffs. In fact, the first layoff we had in Tulsa, this is where I first met Max Roach and J.J. Johnson. They were there. About three bands was in town at the time, off. Right? So Joe Albany, a fine pianist, and Porter Kilbert, another very fine alto saxophonist... And Benny had just made "Malibu" and "Poinciana" and those great tracks that he had made with the band.
